mapper.select: select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, s.gender as gender, s.major_id as majorId, ifnull(m.major_name, '') as majorName, s.class_id as classId, ifnull(c.class_name, '') as className, s.dept_id as deptId, ifnull(d.dept_name, '') as deptName, s.enrollment_year as enrollmentYear, s.education_level as educationLevel, s.student_status as studentStatus, s.user_id as userId from sam_student s left join brm_major m on m.major_id = s.major_id left join brm_class c on c.class_id = s.class_id left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id where s.student_id = #{studentId}

select p.plan_id as planId, p.plan_name as planName, p.major_id as majorId, p.total_credits as totalCredits, p.plan_year as planYear, p.education_level as educationLevel, p.version as version from tpm_training_plan p where p.major_id = #{majorId} and p.publish_status = '1' and p.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.plan_year desc, p.plan_id desc limit 1

select cl.course_id as courseId, cl.course_code as courseCode, cl.course_name as courseName, cl.credit as credit, cl.course_type as courseType, cl.course_category as courseCategory, cl.semester_order as semesterOrder, cl.plan_id as planId, cl.assessment_method as assessmentMethod from tpm_course_library cl where cl.status = '0' and cl.del_flag = '0' and cl.course_id in
#{courseId}

select cs.credit_type as creditType, cs.credit_type_name as creditTypeName, cs.required_credit as requiredCredit, cs.min_credit as minCredit, (select count(1) from tpm_course_library sub where sub.plan_id = cs.plan_id and sub.course_category = cs.credit_type and sub.status = '0' and sub.del_flag = '0') as courseCount from tpm_credit_structure cs where cs.plan_id = #{planId} and cs.status = '0' and cs.del_flag = '0' order by cs.struct_id

select ifnull(cl.course_category, 'UNCATEGORIZED') as creditType, ifnull(sum(cl.credit), 0) as earnedCredit, count(1) as passedCount from aem_grade_record g join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = g.course_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0' and g.is_pass = '1' group by ifnull(cl.course_category, 'UNCATEGORIZED')

select count(1) as courseCount, round(avg(g.total_score), 2) as avgScore, round(sum(case when g.grade_point is not null and g.total_score is not null then g.grade_point * ifnull(cl.credit,0) else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when g.grade_point is not null and g.total_score is not null then ifnull(cl.credit,0) else 0 end), 0), 2) as gpa, sum(case when g.is_pass = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, round(sum(case when g.is_pass = '1' then ifnull(cl.credit, 0) else 0 end), 2) as earnedCredit from aem_grade_record g left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = g.course_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0'

select g.grade_id as gradeId, g.course_id as courseId, cl.course_name as courseName, cl.course_category as courseCategory, ifnull(cl.credit, 0) as credit, g.total_score as totalScore, g.grade_point as gradePoint, g.grade_level as gradeLevel, g.is_pass as isPass, g.semester_id as semesterId, ifnull(smm.semester_name, '') as semesterName, g.submit_status as submitStatus, g.create_time as createTime from aem_grade_record g left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = g.course_id left join brm_semester smm on smm.semester_id = g.semester_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0' order by g.semester_id desc, g.course_id desc limit #{limit}

select ifnull(cl.course_category, 'UNCATEGORIZED') as creditType, count(1) as courseCount, round(avg(g.total_score), 2) as avgScore, round(sum(ifnull(cl.credit, 0)), 2) as totalCredit, round(sum(case when g.is_pass = '1' then ifnull(cl.credit, 0) else 0 end), 2) as earnedCredit from aem_grade_record g join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = g.course_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0' group by ifnull(cl.course_category, 'UNCATEGORIZED') order by avgScore desc
select count(1) as total, sum(case when ifnull(w.is_resolved, '0') = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unresolved, max(w.warning_level) as maxLevel from sam_warning w where w.student_id = #{studentId}

select w.warning_id as warningId, w.warning_type as warningType, w.warning_level as warningLevel, w.warning_reason as warningReason, w.warning_date as warningDate, ifnull(w.is_resolved, '0') as isResolved, smm.semester_name as semesterName from sam_warning w left join brm_semester smm on smm.semester_id = w.semester_id where w.student_id = #{studentId} order by w.warning_date desc, w.warning_id desc limit 10

select count(distinct g.semester_id) as studiedSemesters, max(ifnull(smm.semester_order, 0)) as lastSemesterOrder, max(g.semester_id) as lastSemesterId from aem_grade_record g left join brm_semester smm on smm.semester_id = g.semester_id where g.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = '0'
select round(avg(e.total_score), 2) as globalAvgScore, count(1) as globalCount from aem_evaluation_result e where e.status = '0' and e.course_id is not null and e.total_score is not null
